# Joel Salinas - Human-first AI Strategy Coach

> Joel Salinas helps business leaders and organizations maximize their impact wisely with AI through one-on-one coaching, workflow automation, custom AI application development, and strategic guidance.

## About

Joel Salinas is a Bolivian-born humanitarian, business leader, speaker, writer, and lifelong learner. He is the founder of three AI-powered businesses: Cozora (https://cozora.org), Leadership in Change (https://leadershipinchange.com), and Newsletter Compass (https://newslettercompass.com). He publishes a newsletter read by 3,500+ leaders focused on AI adoption, strategy before tech, and culture over code.

## Services

### Second Brain Build - $450
Build a personal AI knowledge management system using Claude Projects and ChatGPT. Includes custom workflow design, tool configuration, 1-on-1 training, and 30-day support. Typically saves 5-10 hours per week.
URL: https://jsalinas.org/services/second-brain-build.html

### AI Workflow Audit - Starting at $800
Complete workflow analysis and AI opportunity mapping. Includes competitive analysis, 2-3 custom SOPs for high-impact tasks, tool recommendations and setup, and 30-day optimization support. Typical savings of $1,500-3,000/month in time value.
URL: https://jsalinas.org/services/ai-workflow-audit.html

### Executive Coaching - $200/session
1-on-1 strategic guidance on AI strategy, change management, team training, ethical governance, and ROI measurement. 60-minute video calls on a flexible schedule.
URL: https://jsalinas.org/services/executive-coaching.html

### Fractional Chief AI Officer - Monthly Retainer
Executive-level AI leadership on a flexible monthly retainer. Includes AI strategy sessions, governance and policy oversight, use case identification, tool evaluation, team readiness assessment, and ongoing advisory support. Ideal for mid-size companies, nonprofits, and healthcare organizations that need AI leadership without a full-time hire.
URL: https://jsalinas.org/services/fractional-caio.html

### Custom AI App Development - Custom Pricing
Purpose-built AI applications tailored to your exact workflow. You own them outright with no subscriptions and no vendor lock-in. From content systems and internal tools to custom dashboards and team platforms.
URL: https://jsalinas.org/services/custom-ai-apps.html

## Philosophy

- AI should amplify your leadership, not replace it
- Technology serves your mission, not the other way around
- Strategy before tech, culture over code
- Human-first approach to AI adoption
